Seedance 2.5 vs Veo 3.1: cost comparison

Edited by Emmanuel Gonzalez

Some links on this page are affiliate links. Affiliate disclosure.

At 720p, the cheapest Seedance 2.5 is $0.231/s on Replicate (published rate) and the cheapest Veo 3.1 is Veo 3.1 Lite at $0.0222/s on Krea (Basic yearly, Black Friday price, estimated from credit plan; regular $0.0311/s on Krea, Basic yearly at $7/mo), so a 10-second clip costs $2.31 on Replicate vs $0.22 on Krea (regular $0.31 on Krea, Basic yearly). Prices last checked Nov 20, 2026, 5:15 PM ET (2:15 PM PT).

On the same seller: no platform in our data sells both Seedance 2.5 and Veo 3.1 at the same resolution (720p and 1080p), so there is no like-for-like price.

Seedance 2.5 and Veo 3.1 price per second at 720p and 1080p, with 5s to 30s clip totals, on the platforms that sell both. Rebuilt daily.

This page compares 720p and 1080p. Our data has no current 1080p-only Veo 3.1 price; the Gemini API 1080p rows were discontinued Oct 22, 2026, and fal lists one rate for 720p/1080p. Veo 3.1 makes clips of up to 8 seconds, so its 10s, 15s and 30s totals need more than one clip.

    How these numbers work

    • Each price is one row of our price data, copied from the vendor page linked in its row, with the date we checked it.
    • Clip totals are the price per second × the clip length. A length longer than a model's longest single clip needs more than one clip, and the row says how many. Seedance 2.5: up to 30s per clip (as stated in our price data). Veo 3.1: up to 8s per clip (as stated in our price data).
    • Credit-plan rows assumes every credit you pay for is used. Unused credits make the real cost per second higher. Rows labelled estimated are not list prices.
    • Plan or tier, resolution and audio are shown as the vendor states them. "Not listed" and "not stated" mean the vendor page does not say.
    • Rows are ordered by price per second only. Affiliate links never change the order.
    • This page rebuilds with every daily price check. If any row on it goes more than 7 days without a check, the page shows a notice and is hidden from search until it is re-checked. Oldest check on this page: Nov 20, 2026.
